name: YNX Merchant Console
centralIntegration: Accepted DApp Connect SDK source is consumed for EIP-6963/EIP-1193 Standard Wallet. The accepted Endpoint Manifest marks App Gateway UNAVAILABLE and Pay API PENDING, so private merchant service fails closed without disconnecting Standard Wallet.
knownLimitations: Deterministic EIP-6963 approval and rejection are verified, but no real installed Wallet or external browser extension was used.
Product Session v2, settlement, public deployment, installed-client evidence and Computer Control remain false.
Local Chromium verified English UI, guest capability preview, private degradation and zero console errors; this is not public evidence.
